name: DCS Retribution
summary: Dynamic campaign mission generator for DCS World, forked from DCS Liberation.
description: Generates DCS missions from a persistent dynamic campaign, with extra campaign features and mod-aircraft support. It is a separate program distributed as a zip you extract and run.

releases.changelog: Invisible/neutral FOBs, influence zones, DCS 2.9.20 support incl. MiG-29A, MOOSE base plugin, mod updates and fixes.
